item.title: Zero-Command Private AI Assistant: A Full Hermes Console Tutorial
item.description: Want your own AI assistant but gave up at the first sight of a terminal? Hermes Console turns the whole setup into clicks: double-click to start, configure in the browser, scan a QR code to live inside WeChat. This is the full walkthrough, plus what it actually does under the hood.
